objective: When a persistent goal ends (cancelled, expired or achieved) in apps/local-control/src/agent/goals.mjs its running mission keeps going. On finishing, persist the terminal state with missionStopPending: true (when the goal has a missionId) before cancelling the mission through missions.control(id, "cancel"); clear the flag once the mission is done or missing. If the stop fails or is not acknowledged, record a mission_stop_failed observation and throw GoalError MISSION_STOP_FAILED (HTTP 503 in goal-routes.mjs) while keeping the intent; add GoalStore.pendingMissionStops() and retry pending stops on every tick without waking the ended goal. A refused stop must not block other goals expiring or lose events. apps/local-control/tests/goal-cancellation.test.mjs and goals.test.mjs must pass.
